config.design: Cached H732 native logits, all valid sentiment and capital-recall endpoints. Original answer sets versus symmetric surface-form expansions: canonical labels with lower/title/upper case and zero/one leading space; expanded existing semantic set with same case/space variants. Only exact single-token continuations with unchanged prompt tokenization retained; deduplicate token IDs and enforce class disjointness. Rules fixed before reading predictions in this audit. Report original replay, contrast/top1, candidate mass/ranks and native top5. No selected-case filtering.
config.limitations: Posthoc measurement audit of previously inspected failures; alternative scoring is diagnostic, not retroactive validation of old causal metrics. Multi-token answers or delayed whitespace/newline answers are not scored here.
